text:
alex: hey team — fresh start today! quick ask: can someone point me to the right people for badge, github org access, aws creds, and who owns the Dedicated onboarding docs? trying to make a checklist for my first week 

devex: welcome alex :tada:  short map below, ping the person/alias and include your employee id. also see onboarding playbook: https://handbook.redwood.ai/onboard/new-hires

maria: badge + hardware logistics = people-ops. send an email to people-ops@redwood.ai with 'New Hire: Alex' in subject. they'll reply with pickup window and hardware form.

sam: infra access / infra-oncall stuff -> eng-infra channel. for GH org access add @devex as reviewer and include repo list. if you need AWS console access, use the access-request bot: `curl -X POST https://access.redwood.ai/req -d '{"user":"alex","role":"dev-starter"}'` (it creates a ticket for infra team).

jamie: Dedicated onboarding / deployments = eng-platform. My doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/dedicated/onboard covers required infra, model pinning, and rollout checklist. If you want a walkthrough, DM me and we can schedule 30m.

alex: thanks! what's the escalation path if something is blocking deploys or access mid-sprint?

sam: escalate in this order: 1) ping the owner in the thread (e.g., eng-platform/eng-infra) 2) @oncall-eng-infra if after-hours 3) page oncall via PagerDuty if it's P1. For urgent infra incidents, add `!page` in eng-infra channel.

oncall-bot: Eng Infra oncall rota: today — Sam; tomorrow — Priya. PagerDuty link: https://pd.redwood.ai/org/infra

devex: small checklist to copy into your notes: 
- badge: people-ops@redwood.ai (subject: New Hire: Alex)
- mac + peripherals: attach hardware form in reply
- GH access: open GH request, add @devex reviewer, list repos
- AWS creds: request via access-request bot, then infra will set IAM roles
- VPN / Okta: self-serve link in handbook -> follow 2FA setup
- Dedicated onboarding: ping eng-platform for walkthrough

maria: FYI payroll + benefits folks need your W-4/contract signed, check Payroll portal (welcome email sent).

alex: perfect. i'll start filling things out and DM jamie for the dedicated walkthrough. really appreciate the quick map :heart:

devex: any time — shout if you hit a blocker. also adding this thread to the new-hire handbook thread list for future hires. :sparkles:
